description: A Java class implementing a MIME type filter supporting filtering by MIME types and file extensions, used for web share target filtering and within Chrome's photo picker.

classes.name: MimeTypeFilter
classes.description: A filter class for MIME types and file extensions, implementing FileFilter.

methods.name: MimeTypeFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing MIME type and extension filters based on provided list and directory acceptance flag.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if a URI and MIME type are accepted by the filter.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if a File object is accepted by the filter, considering directory acceptance.

methods.name: getMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type from file extension using MimeTypeMap.

methods.name: getMimeSupertype
methods.description: Extracts the supertype (type before '/') from a MIME type string.
